newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures close barely firmer, slip from highs.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures close barely firmer, slip from highs.

text.p: FCOJ July futures finished firmer but below the nine-day highs hit earlier in the session, trading sources said.
Fund buying carried the spot month to 75.75 cents a lb, where the trade emerged to block the contract from reaching its upside target of 80.80 cents.
July eased slightly below unchanged before eking out gains by the close.
Despite four straight sessions of higher prices, the market is not expected to maintain a positive tone as the underlying fundamentals remain negatove.

USDA will release its next crop estimate June 12. Market analysts do not expect any changes from the previous report, which put the Florida crop at a record 224.2 million 90-lb boxes and yields at 1.58 gallons per box.
Resistance remained at 80.80 cents for July juice.
July futures settled up 0.20 cent at 79.45 cents after trading from 80.75 to 78.95 cents. Second position September finished 0.30 cent higher at 81.65 cents.
Volume was estimated at 2,000 lots, compared with Wednesday's official 1,955 lots.
